scope: Correct and simplify existing counter collision proposals; add a measured economical derivative of the shared flange; close interface and compact-source restoration ambiguities. No original game reconstruction or engine adoption.

counter_collision.limit: Measured finite overreach, not global Hausdorff or native physics bound. Chord parameters do not equal total error.

flange_derivative.detail_selection: Explicit repeated/distant candidate; retain original detailed masters for inspection. No engine LOD or distance threshold is installed.

limitations: Offline component geometry, interfaces and source-rebuild evidence only
Original game, room/actor/controller use, engine physics, LOD switching and target-PC performance remain untested
Static and separable-only geometry is not assigned invented motion or interaction behavior
No new artistic family; derived alternatives and comparison fixtures are not added designs
